item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i gdams pa
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gcod gdams las/ rjes kyi tshogs 'khor rim pa ni/ bskal (skal) pa bzang mos gsung bzhin du/ sprul sku khro gnyan rgyal mtshan gyis/ 'gro ba'i don du yi ger bkod/ mkha' 'gro gnyan la bzod par gsol/ sems can don du phan par shog/
